hardBoundaries: All labels remain source-local; cross-study mapping status is not_established for every lane.
Public access to metadata or files does not establish asset-level reuse permission, license compatibility, or project admission.
No source cell, nucleus, spot, section, or morphology is registered to project coordinates; projectRegistrationCount is 0.
A blank or not_measured axis is a coverage gap, not evidence that the biological feature is absent.
Co-display across lanes does not establish same-cell identity, lineage continuity, anatomical correspondence, or causation.
No morphology may be synthesized as observed evidence from transcriptomic labels, marker expression, laminar enrichment, or spatial transcriptomic signal.

The Iglesias González lane admits only M1–M6 group summaries from one pooled preparation: three embryos → one tube → one library and 384 wells → 354 QC-retained cells → 274 dI6-lineage cells; no per-well group roster or scalar pseudotime is exported or reconstructed.
The Iglesias González lane admits no exact cross-study identity, cell geometry, internal structure or atlas registration.

The Roome lane admits an exact 157-label Table S6 molecular roster and Table S7 differential evidence, but no type-specific morphology, whole-cell geometry, internal structure, same-cell scRNA–Xenium join or atlas registration.
Twenty-six apparent Excel-date tokens in Roome Table S7 gene cells remain quarantined and are never auto-repaired into gene symbols.
